entities.name: Charles Le Gobien
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Le Gobien was a French Jesuit writer, founder of the Lettres édifiantes et curieuses, a collection of reports from Jesuit missionaries in China. It is a major source of information for the history of Catholic missions and life in China in those times.
